sample.limitText: Upgrade your plan to invite more people.
sample.failedText: M-Pesa did not confirm the payment. Ask the customer to try again.
sample.infoText: Head office updated 24 prices for all branches.
sample.emptyText: No purchase orders yet. Create one from a requisition.
sample.cardBody: Westlands leads today with 42% of sales.
sample.dialogBody: The sale stays in the audit log and the stock goes back on the shelf.

errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.profileText: Check your connection, then try again.

codes.last_owner: Your organisation needs at least one active Owner. Give the Owner role to someone else first.
codes.cannot_grant: You can only give roles whose permissions you hold, where you manage access. Only an Owner can give or remove the Owner role.
codes.invitation_stale: This invitation no longer matches your organisation’s setup. Ask your administrator to send a new one.
codes.contact_unverified: This person never verified an email or phone number, so they can’t be reactivated. Invite them again instead.
codes.system_role: System roles can’t be changed. Copy the role to customise it.
codes.device_suspended: This device is suspended. Resume it before unpairing it.
codes.device_not_pairable: This device is already paired or suspended. Unpair it before pairing it again.
codes.device_not_suspended: This device isn’t suspended, so there is nothing to resume.
codes.forbidden: You don’t have permission to do this. Ask an administrator if you need it.

auth.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters. Avoid common passwords.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the email or phone number you signed up with.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.intro: Set up your business. You can add companies, branches and people later.
signUp.contactHelp: For a phone number, start with the country code, for example +254 712 345 678.

verify.title: Enter your code
verify.intro: Enter the 6-digit code we sent you.
verify.missingText: Sign in again and a new code will be sent if your account still needs one.
verify.resent: A new code is on its way.

twoFactor.title: Two-step sign-in
twoFactor.intro: Enter the code from your authenticator app or the text message we sent.
twoFactor.missingText: Sign in again to get a new code.

enrol.title: Set up two-step sign-in
enrol.intro: Your role requires a second step when you sign in. Set it up to continue.
enrol.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
enrol.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
enrol.manual: Or enter this key by hand:

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email or phone number and we will send you a code.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Enter the code and your new password. You will be signed out everywhere.
reset.sentText: If an account exists for this login, a 6-digit code is on its way. It expires in 30 minutes.
reset.done: Your password has changed. Sign in with the new one.

invitation.title: Join your team
invitation.intro: {{business}} invited you. Choose a password to finish setting up your account.
invitation.unavailableText: It may have expired, been used or been withdrawn. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
invitation.signedInText: This invitation creates a new account. Sign out first, then accept it.

start.title: Get started
start.subtitle: A few steps to set up your business
start.organisationText: Add companies, branches and the locations where you sell.
start.usersText: Give each person a role at the right company, branch or location.
start.appearanceText: Pick a theme for your workspace.

empty.title: Today
empty.heading: Nothing to show yet
empty.text: Sales, stock alerts and approvals appear here once you start selling.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved.

noAccess.title: You do not have access to this page
noAccess.text: Ask an administrator to give you a role that includes it.

users.title: Users
users.description: People in your business, their roles and where they work.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: What each role can do, and where.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how the workspace looks on this account.

themes.light: Near-white surfaces with a deep teal accent.
themes.executive: Graphite sidebar, emerald brand and gold actions.
themes.warm: Paper tones with a bronze brand.

appearance.brandText: See how a business's own colours would look. Nothing is saved.
appearance.brandNoticeText: Primary and decisive-action colours are replaced until you reset or reload.
appearance.previewText: Sample controls in the current theme

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Devices where you are signed in. Sign out of any you do not recognise.
sessions.confirmText: You will go back to the sign-in page. Your other sessions stay signed in.

organisation.empty: No companies yet. Add the first one to start building your organisation.
organisation.emptyReadOnly: Nothing in your organisation is assigned to you yet.

company.archiveText: The company and its history stay, but no one can add branches to it or sell under it until you restore it.

branch.archiveText: The branch and its history stay, but no one can add locations to it until you restore it.

location.archiveText: The location and its sales history stay, but no device can be added or paired here until you restore it.

fields.name: Name
fields.legalNameHelp: As registered. Leave empty to use the name.
fields.countryHelp: Sets the currency and time zone. It can’t be changed later.
fields.codeHelp: Up to 20 letters, numbers or dashes, such as WSTL. Used on receipts and reports.

lastActive.company: This is your only active company. Add another company before archiving this one.
lastActive.branch: This is your only active branch. Add another branch before archiving this one.
lastActive.location: This is your only active location. Add another location before archiving this one.

hasActiveChildren.company: This company still has active branches. Archive them first.
hasActiveChildren.branch: This branch still has active locations. Archive them first.
hasActiveChildren.location: This location still has devices that are paired, waiting to pair or suspended. Unpair them first.

parentArchived.company: This company is archived. Restore it before adding to it.
parentArchived.branch: The company of this branch is archived. Restore the company first.
parentArchived.location: The branch of this location is archived. Restore the branch first.
parentArchived.device: This location is archived. Restore it before adding or pairing devices.

devices.title: Devices at {{location}}
devices.name: Device name
devices.nameHelp: A name people recognise at the till, such as Till 1.
devices.empty: No devices yet. Add one to pair a till here.
devices.codeIntro: Enter this code on the device to pair it with this location.
devices.codeExpiry: It works once and is valid until {{time}}.
devices.codeOnce: You won’t see this code again. If it expires, get a new one.
devices.suspendText: Suspending is temporary: the device stays paired but can’t sign in or sell until you resume it.
devices.suspendLost: If the device is lost or stolen, unpair it instead so its access ends for good.
devices.unpairText: The device is signed out at once and needs a new pairing code to sell again. Its sales history stays.

empty.active: No active users in your part of the organisation yet.
empty.invitations: No pending invitations. Invite someone to give them access.

users.revokeText: The link stops working at once. You can send a new invitation later.

invite.title: Invite a user
invite.description: They get a link to choose a password and join with the roles you give here.
invite.contactHelp: The invitation link is sent here. Use an international number, such as +254 712 345 678.
invite.rolesText: Give at least one role, and say where it applies. A branch role covers its locations; a company role covers its branches.
invite.sent: Invitation sent to {{name}}. It is valid for 7 days.

assignment.tenantHelp: Every company, branch and location, including ones added later.

detail.noRoles: No roles yet. Give one so this person can work.
detail.removeText: {{name}} loses what this role allows there at once. Their history stays.
detail.notFound: This user doesn’t exist or isn’t in your part of the organisation.
detail.signOutText: Every session ends now, on computers, phones and tills. They can sign in again with their password.
detail.signOutSelfText: Every one of your sessions ends now, including this one. You can sign in again with your password.
detail.deactivateText: They are signed out everywhere at once and can’t sign in until someone reactivates them. Their roles and history stay.
detail.deactivateSelfText: You will be signed out at once and can’t sign in until someone reactivates you.
detail.reactivateText: They can sign in again with their password and get the roles they held.

roles.copyText: The copy starts with the same permissions and is yours to change.
roles.empty: No roles yet. Create one to group permissions.
roles.newText: Name the role and choose what it allows.
roles.systemText: Copy this role to make your own version, then change its permissions.

fields.name: Role name
fields.twoFactorHelp: People with this role must set up two-factor sign-in before they can continue.

roles.twoFactorOn: Two-factor sign-in is now required for this role.
roles.twoFactorOff: Two-factor sign-in is no longer required for this role.
roles.archiveText: People who hold this role lose its permissions at once. Their other roles and history stay.
